129: {
130: #ifdef CONFIG_WATCHDOG

132: #endif

134: 
135: #ifdef CONFIG_SPI_DRIVER

137: #endif

139: #ifdef CONFIG_SPI_SLAVE_DRIVER

141: #endif

143: #ifdef CONFIG_ONESHOT
144:   int ret = OK;
145:   struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *os_lower = NULL;
146: 
147:   os_lower = oneshot_initialize(TIMER_ID1, 0);
148:   if (os_lower != NULL)
149:     {
150:       ret = oneshot_register("/dev/oneshot", os_lower);
151:       if (ret < 0)
152:         {
153:           sinfo("ERROR: Failed to register oneshot at /dev/oneshot: %d\n", ret);
154:         }
155:     }
156:   else
157:     {
158:       return -EBUSY;
159:     }
160: #endif
161: 
162: #ifdef CONFIG_VND_CAL
163:   vnd_cal_overlay();
164: #endif
165:   bk_pm_module_vote_cpu_freq(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT, PM_CPU_FRQ_120M);
166: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7236N_WIFI

169:   bk_wifi_init(&wifi_config);
170: #ifdef CONFIG_WIFI_PS_DISABLE

172: #endif
173:   beken_netdriver_init();
174: #endif
175: 
176: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7236N_BLE
177:   bk_bluetooth_init();
178: #endif
179: 
180: #ifdef CONFIG_ROSC_CALIB_SW
181:   bk_rosc_32k_calib();
182: #endif
183: 
184: #if defined(CONFIG_DEV_GPIO) && !defined(CONFIG_GPIO_LOWER_HALF)
185:   ret = beken_gpio_init();
186:   if (ret < 0)
187:     {
188:       gpioerr("Failed to initialize GPIO Driver: %d\n", ret);
189:     }
190: #endif
191: 
192: #if defined(CONFIG_PWM)
193:   beken_pwm_initialize("/dev/pwm0", 0);
194: #endif
195: 
196: #if defined(CONFIG_CAPTURE)
197:   beken_capture_initialize("/dev/capture0", 4);
198: #endif
199: 
200: #if defined(CONFIG_I2C_DRIVER)
201:   board_i2cdev_initialize(0);
202: #endif
203: 
204: #if defined(CONFIG_ADC)
205:   beken_adc_initialize("/dev/adc0", 0);
206: #endif
207: 
208: #if defined(CONFIG_BK7236N_MTD_PARTITION) && defined (CONFIG_KVDB_NVS) && defined (CONFIG_CM_KVDB_TEST)
209:   struct mtd_dev_s *mtd = beken_alloc_mtdpart(CONFIG_BK7236N_MTD_PARTITION_OFFSET,
210:                                               CONFIG_BK7236N_MTD_PARTITION_SIZE,
211:                                               false);
212:   ret = mtdconfig_register(mtd);
213:   if (ret < 0)
214:     {
215:        ferr("Failed to register MTD config:%d\n", ret);
216:     }
217: 
218:   struct mtd_dev_s *rammtd = rammtd_initialize(g_rammtd, RAM_MTD_SIZE);
219:   if (!rammtd)
220:     {
221:       ferr("Failed to create RAM MTD instance\n");
222:     }
223:   MTD_IOCTL(rammtd, MTDIOC_BULKERASE, 0);
224:   ret = mtdconfig_register_by_path(rammtd, CONFIG_KVDB_TEMPORARY_PATH);
225:   if (ret < 0)
226:     {
227:       ferr("Failed to register ram MTD: %d\n", ret);
228:     }
229: 
230: #elif defined(CONFIG_BK7236N_MTD_PARTITION)
231:   struct mtd_dev_s *mtd = beken_alloc_mtdpart(CONFIG_BK7236N_MTD_PARTITION_OFFSET,
232:                                               CONFIG_BK7236N_MTD_PARTITION_SIZE,
233:                                               false);
234:   ret = register_mtddriver(CONFIG_BK7236N_MTD_PARTITION_DEVPATH,
235:                                   mtd, 0755, NULL);
236:   if (ret < 0)
237:     {
238:        ferr("Failed to register MTD driver:%d\n", ret);
239:     }

264:  *   suitable for early initialization of most, simple device drivers and
265:  *   is a logical, board-specific extension of up_initialize().

270:  *   cannot wait for event.  Waiting may be required, for example, to
271:  *   mount a file system or or initialize a device such as an SD card.
272:  *   For this reason, such driver initialize must be deferred to

390:  *         matching application logic.  The value could be such things as a

44: /****************************************************************************
45:  * Pre-processor Definitions
46:  ****************************************************************************/
47: 
48: /* Get a 32-bit version of the default priority */
49: 
50: #define DEFPRIORITY32 \
51:   (NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT << 24 | \
52:    NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT << 16 | \
53:    NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT << 8  | \
54:    NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT)
55: 
56: /* Given the address of a NVIC ENABLE register, this is the offset to
57:  * the corresponding CLEAR ENABLE register.
58:  */
59: 
60: #define NVIC_ENA_OFFSET    (0)
61: #define NVIC_CLRENA_OFFSET (NVIC_IRQ0_31_CLEAR - NVIC_IRQ0_31_ENABLE)
62: 
63: /****************************************************************************
64:  * Private Data
65:  ****************************************************************************/
66: 
67: /****************************************************************************
68:  * External Functions
69:  ****************************************************************************/
70: 
71: extern void user_nmi_handler(uint32_t lr, uint32_t sp);
72: 
73: /****************************************************************************
74:  * Private Functions
75:  ****************************************************************************/
76: 
77: /****************************************************************************
78:  * Name: bk7236_nmi, bk7236_pendsv, bk7236_pendsv, bk7236_reserved
79:  *
80:  * Description:
81:  *   Handlers for various exceptions.  None are handled and all are fatal
82:  *   error conditions.  The only advantage these provide over the default
83:  *   unexpected interrupt handler is that they provide a diagnostic output.
84:  *
85:  ****************************************************************************/
86: 
87: static int bk7236_nmi(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
88: {
89:   uint32_t msp_val, lr_val;
90:   up_irq_save();
91:   bk_misc_set_reset_reason(RESET_SOURCE_NMI_WDT);
92:   __asm__ volatile (
93:       "MRS %0, msp      \n"
94:       "MOV %1, lr       \n"
95:       "push {r4-r11}    \n"
96:       : "=r" (msp_val), "=r" (lr_val)
97:   );
98:   user_nmi_handler(lr_val, msp_val);
99:   while(1);
100:   return 0;
101: }
102: 
103: static int bk7236_pendsv(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
104: {
105:   up_irq_save();
106:   _err("PANIC!!! PendSV received\n");
107:   PANIC();
108:   return 0;
109: }
110: 
111: static int bk7236_reserved(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
112: {
113:   up_irq_save();
114:   _err("PANIC!!! Reserved interrupt\n");
115:   PANIC();
116:   return 0;
117: }
118: 
119: /****************************************************************************
120:  * Name: bk7236_prioritize_syscall
121:  *
122:  * Description:
123:  *   Set the SVCall exception priority.  This must be higher than
124:  *   NVIC_SYSH_DISABLE_PRIORITY so that context switches via SVC still work
125:  *   while enter_critical_section() has raised BASEPRI.
126:  *
127:  ****************************************************************************/
128: 
129: static inline void bk7236_prioritize_syscall(int priority)
130: {
131:   uint32_t regval;
132: 
133:   /* SVCALL is system handler 11 */
134: 
135:   regval  = getreg32(NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
136:   regval &= ~NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR11_MASK;
137:   regval |= (priority << NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR11_SHIFT);
138:   putreg32(regval, NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
139: }
140: 
141: /****************************************************************************
142:  * Name: bk7236_irqinfo
143:  *
144:  * Description:
145:  *   Given an IRQ number, provide the register and bit setting to enable or
146:  *   disable the irq.
147:  *
148:  ****************************************************************************/
149: 
150: static int bk7236_irqinfo(int irq, uintptr_t *regaddr, uint32_t *bit,
151:                          uintptr_t offset)
152: {
153:   int n;
154: 
155:   DEBUGASSERT(irq >= BK7236N_IRQ_NMI && irq < NR_IRQS);
156: 
157:   /* Check for external interrupt */
158: 
159:   if (irq >= BK7236N_IRQ_FIRST)
160:     {
161:       n        = irq - BK7236N_IRQ_FIRST;
162:       *regaddr = NVIC_IRQ_ENABLE(n) + offset;
163:       *bit     = (uint32_t)1 << (n & 0x1f);
164:     }
165: 
166:   /* Handle processor exceptions.  Only a few can be disabled */
167: 
168:   else
169:     {
170:       *regaddr = NVIC_SYSHCON;
171:       if (irq == BK7236N_IRQ_MEMFAULT)
172:         {
173:           *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_MEMFAULTENA;
174:         }
175:       else if (irq == BK7236N_IRQ_BUSFAULT)
176:         {
177:           *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_BUSFAULTENA;
178:         }
179:       else if (irq == BK7236N_IRQ_USAGEFAULT)
180:         {
181:           *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_USGFAULTENA;
182:         }
183:       else if (irq == BK7236N_IRQ_SYSTICK)
184:         {
185:           *regaddr = NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL;
186:           *bit = NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_ENABLE;
187:         }
188:       else
189:         {
190:           return ERROR; /* Invalid or unsupported exception */
191:         }
192:     }
193: 
194:   return OK;
195: }
196: 
197: /****************************************************************************
198:  * Public Functions
199:  ****************************************************************************/
200: 
201: /****************************************************************************
202:  * Name: up_irqinitialize
203:  ****************************************************************************/
204: 
205: void up_irqinitialize(void)
206: {
207:   uint32_t regaddr;
208:   int num_priority_registers;
209:   int i;
210: 
211:   /* Disable all interrupts */
212: 
213:   for (i = 0; i < NR_IRQS - BK7236N_IRQ_FIRST; i += 32)
214:     {
215:       putreg32(0xffffffff, NVIC_IRQ_CLEAR(i));
216:     }
217: 
218: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_RAMVECTORS
219:   /* If CONFIG_ARCH_RAMVECTORS is defined, then we are using a RAM-based
220:    * vector table that requires special initialization.
221:    */
222:   arm_ramvec_initialize();
223: #endif
224: 
225:   /* Set all interrupts (and exceptions) to the default priority */
226: 
227:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH4_7_PRIORITY);
228:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
229:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH12_15_PRIORITY);
230: 
231:   /* The NVIC ICTR register (bits 0-4) holds the number of interrupt
232:    * lines that the NVIC supports:
233:    *
234:    *  0 -> 32 interrupt lines,  8 priority registers
235:    *  1 -> 64 "       " "   ", 16 priority registers
236:    *  2 -> 96 "       " "   ", 32 priority registers
237:    *  ...
238:    */
239: 
240:   num_priority_registers = (getreg32(NVIC_ICTR) + 1) * 8;
241: 
242:   /* Now set all of the interrupt lines to the default priority */
243:   regaddr = NVIC_IRQ0_3_PRIORITY;
244:   while (num_priority_registers--)
245:     {
246:       putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, regaddr);
247:       regaddr += 4;
248:     }
249: 
250:   /* Attach the SVCall and Hard Fault exception handlers */
251:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_SVCALL, arm_svcall, NULL);
252:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_HARDFAULT, arm_hardfault, NULL);
253: 
254:   /* SVCall must preempt BASEPRI masked critical sections for context switch */
255: 
256:   bk7236_prioritize_syscall(NVIC_SYSH_SVCALL_PRIORITY);
257: 
258:   /* If the MPU is enabled, then attach and enable the Memory Management
259:    * Fault handler.
260:    */
261: 
262: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM_MPU
263:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_MEMFAULT, arm_memfault, NULL);
264:   up_enable_irq(BK7236N_IRQ_MEMFAULT);
265: #endif
266:   /* Attach all other processor exceptions (except reset and sys tick) */
267: 
268:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_NMI, bk7236_nmi, NULL);
269: #ifndef CONFIG_ARM_MPU
270:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_MEMFAULT, arm_memfault, NULL);
271: #endif
272:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_BUSFAULT, arm_busfault, NULL);
273:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_USAGEFAULT, arm_usagefault, NULL);
274:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_PENDSV, bk7236_pendsv, NULL);
275:   arm_enable_dbgmonitor();
276:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_DBGMONITOR, arm_dbgmonitor, NULL);
277:   irq_attach(BK7236N_IRQ_RESERVED, bk7236_reserved, NULL);
278: 
279:   /* Enable interrupts */
280:   up_irq_enable();
281: }
282: 
283: /****************************************************************************
284:  * Name: up_enable_irq
285:  *
286:  * Description:
287:  *   Enable the interrupt specified by 'irq'
288:  *
289:  ****************************************************************************/
290: 
291: void up_enable_irq(int irq)
292: {
293:   uintptr_t regaddr;
294:   uint32_t regval;
295:   uint32_t bit;
296: 
297:   if (bk7236_irqinfo(irq, &regaddr, &bit, NVIC_ENA_OFFSET) == 0)
298:     {
299:       /* Modify the appropriate bit in the register to enable the interrupt.
300:        * For normal interrupts, we need to set the bit in the associated
301:        * Interrupt Set Enable register.  For other exceptions, we need to
302:        * set the bit in the System Handler Control and State Register.
303:        */
304: 
305:       if (irq >= BK7236N_IRQ_FIRST)
306:         {
307:           putreg32(bit, regaddr);
308:         }
309:       else
310:         {
311:           regval  = getreg32(regaddr);
312:           regval |= bit;
313:           putreg32(regval, regaddr);
314:         }
315:     }
316: }
317: 
318: /****************************************************************************
319:  * Name: up_disable_irq
320:  *
321:  * Description:
322:  *   Disable the interrupt specified by 'irq'
323:  *
324:  ****************************************************************************/
325: 
326: void up_disable_irq(int irq)
327: {
328:   uintptr_t regaddr;
329:   uint32_t regval;
330:   uint32_t bit;
331: 
332:   if (bk7236_irqinfo(irq, &regaddr, &bit, NVIC_CLRENA_OFFSET) == 0)
333:     {
334:       /* Modify the appropriate bit in the register to disable the interrupt.
335:        * For normal interrupts, we need to set the bit in the associated
336:        * Interrupt Clear Enable register.  For other exceptions, we need to
337:        * clear the bit in the System Handler Control and State Register.
338:        */
339: 
340:       if (irq >= BK7236N_IRQ_FIRST)
341:         {
342:           putreg32(bit, regaddr);
343:         }
344:       else
345:         {
346:           regval  = getreg32(regaddr);
347:           regval &= ~bit;
348:           putreg32(regval, regaddr);
349:         }
350:     }
351: }
352: 
353: /****************************************************************************
354:  * Name: arm_ack_irq
355:  *
356:  * Description:
357:  *   Acknowledge the IRQ
358:  *
359:  ****************************************************************************/
360: 
361: void arm_ack_irq(int irq)
362: {
363: 
364: }
365: 
366: /****************************************************************************
367:  * Name: up_prioritize_irq
368:  *
369:  * Description:
370:  *   Set the priority of an IRQ.
371:  *
372:  *   Since this API is not supported on all architectures, it should be
373:  *   avoided in common implementations where possible.
374:  *
375:  ****************************************************************************/
376: 
377: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_IRQPRIO
378: int up_prioritize_irq(int irq, int priority)
379: {
380:   uint32_t regaddr;
381:   uint32_t regval;
382:   int shift;
383: 
384:   DEBUGASSERT(irq >= BK7236N_IRQ_MEMFAULT && irq < NR_IRQS &&
385:             (unsigned)priority <= NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_MIN);
386: 
387:   if (irq < BK7236N_IRQ_FIRST)
388:     {
389:       /* NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY() maps {0..15} to one of three priority
390:        * registers (0-3 are invalid)
391:        */
392: 
393:       regaddr = NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY(irq);
394:       irq    -= 4;
395:     }
396:   else
397:     {
398:       /* NVIC_IRQ_PRIORITY() maps {0..} to one of many priority registers */
399: 
400:       irq    -= BK7236N_IRQ_FIRST;
401:       regaddr = NVIC_IRQ_PRIORITY(irq);
402:     }
403: 
404:   regval      = getreg32(regaddr);
405:   shift       = ((irq & 3) << 3);
406:   regval     &= ~(0xff << shift);
407:   regval     |= (priority << shift);
408:   putreg32(regval, regaddr);
409: 
410:   return OK;
411: }
412: #endif
413:

173:  * Name: up_pm_notify

196:                               enum pm_state_e pmstate)

201:         {
202:           /* Logic for PM_NORMAL goes here */
203:           sinfo("Switch to PM_NORMAL \r\n");
204:         }
205:         break;
206: 
207:       case (PM_IDLE):

209:           /* Logic for PM_IDLE goes here */

220:

222:         {
223:           /* Logic for PM_SLEEP goes here */

370:  *   Configure the UART to operation in interrupt driven mode.  This method

372:  *   the the setup() method is called, however, the serial console may
373:  *   operate in a non-interrupt driven mode during the boot phase.

390: {

392:

394:   int ret;

462:  * Name: beken_serial_receive
463:  *
464:  * Description:
465:  *   Called (usually) from the interrupt level to receive one
466:  *   character from the UART.  Error bits associated with the
467:  *   receipt are provided in the return 'status'.
468:  *
469:  * Parameters:
470:  *   dev        -  Pointer to the serial driver struct.
471:  *   status     -  Pointer to a variable to store eventual error bits.
472:  *
473:  * Returned Values:
474:  *   Return the byte read from the RX FIFO.
475:  *
476:  ****************************************************************************/
477: 
478: static int beken_serial_receive(struct uart_dev_s *dev,
479:                                         unsigned int *status)
480: {
481:   DEBUGASSERT(dev != NULL);
482:   uint32_t rx_fifo;
483:   uint8_t rx_data;
484:   struct beken_serial_cfg *priv =(struct beken_serial_cfg *) dev->priv;
485: 
486:   bk_uart_read_bytes(priv->uart_id, &rx_data, 1, 0);
487:   rx_fifo = rx_data & 0xFF;
488: 
489:   /* Since we don't have error bits associated with receipt, we set zero */
490: 
491:   *status = 0;
492: 
493:   return  (int) rx_fifo;
494: }

53: /****************************************************************************
54:  * Name: up_allocate_heap/up_allocate_kheap
55:  *
56:  * Description:
57:  *   This function will be called to dynamically set aside the heap region.
58:  *
59:  *   - For the normal "flat" build, this function returns the size of the
60:  *     single heap.
61:  *   - For the protected build (CONFIG_BUILD_PROTECTED=y) with both kernel-
62:  *     and user-space heaps (CONFIG_MM_KERNEL_HEAP=y), this function
63:  *     provides the size of the unprotected, user-space heap.
64:  *   - For the kernel build (CONFIG_BUILD_KERNEL=y), this function provides
65:  *     the size of the protected, kernel-space heap.
66:  *
67:  *   If a protected kernel-space heap is provided, the kernel heap must be
68:  *   allocated by an analogous up_allocate_kheap(). A custom version of this
69:  *   file is needed if memory protection of the kernel heap is required.
70:  *
71:  *   The following memory map is assumed for the flat build:
72:  *
73:  *     .data region.  Size determined at link time.
74:  *     .bss  region  Size determined at link time.
75:  *     IDLE thread stack.  Size determined by CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE.
76:  *     Heap.  Extends to the end of SRAM.
77:  *
78:  *   The following memory map is assumed for the kernel build:
79:  *
80:  *     Kernel .data region.  Size determined at link time.
81:  *     Kernel .bss  region  Size determined at link time.
82:  *     Kernel IDLE thread stack.  Size determined by
83:  *       CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE.
84:  *     Padding for alignment
85:  *     User .data region.  Size determined at link time.
86:  *     User .bss region  Size determined at link time.
87:  *     Kernel heap.  Size determined by CONFIG_MM_KERNEL_HEAPSIZE.
88:  *     User heap.  Extends to the end of SRAM.
89:  *
90:  ****************************************************************************/
91: 
92: void up_allocate_heap(FAR void **heap_start, size_t *heap_size)
93: {
94:   uintptr_t ubase;
95:   uintptr_t utop;
96:   size_t    usize;
97: 
98:   ubase = (uintptr_t)_ebss + CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE;
99:   utop = (uintptr_t)_eram;
100:   usize = utop - ubase;
101: 
102:   DEBUGASSERT(utop > ubase);
103: 
104:   *heap_start = (void *)ubase;
105:   *heap_size  = usize;
106: }

92:       {

95:         bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(0,0x0,0x0);

100: /****************************************************************************
101:  * Name: up_idlepm
102:  *
103:  * Description:
104:  *   Perform IDLE state power management.
105:  *
106:  * Input Parameters:
107:  *   NULL.
108:  *
109:  * Returned Value:
110:  *   NULL.
111:  *
112:  ****************************************************************************/
113: 
114: static void up_idlepm(void)
115: {
116:   static enum pm_state_e oldstate = PM_NORMAL;
117:   enum pm_state_e newstate;
118:   irqstate_t flags;
119:   int ret;
120: 
121:   /* Decide, which power saving level can be obtained */
122: 
123:   newstate = pm_checkstate(PM_IDLE_DOMAIN);
124: 
125:   /* Check for state changes */
126: 
127:   if (newstate != oldstate)
128:     {
129:       flags = enter_critical_section();
130: 
131:       /* Perform board-specific, state-dependent logic here */
132: 
133:       _info("newstate= %d oldstate=%d\n", newstate, oldstate);
134: 
135:       /* Then force the global state change */
136: 
137:       ret = pm_changestate(PM_IDLE_DOMAIN, newstate);
138:       if (ret < 0)
139:         {
140:           /* The new state change failed, revert to the preceding state */
141: 
142:           pm_changestate(PM_IDLE_DOMAIN, oldstate);
143:         }
144:       else
145:         {
146:           /* Save the new state */
147: 
148:           oldstate = newstate;
149:         }
150: 
151:       /* MCU-specific power management logic */
152: 
153:       leave_critical_section(flags);
154: 
155:       switch (newstate)
156:         {
157:         case PM_NORMAL:
158:           sleep_mode = PM_MODE_DEFAULT;
159:           break;
160: 
161:         case PM_IDLE:
162:           sleep_mode = PM_MODE_NORMAL_SLEEP;
163:           break;
164: 
165:         case PM_STANDBY:
166:           _info("Device will enter the standby mode\n");
167:           bk_gpio_register_isr(GPIO_12, beken_gpio_wakeup_int_wrppper);
168:           bk_gpio_register_wakeup_source(GPIO_12,GPIO_INT_TYPE_FALLING_EDGE);
169:           bk_pm_wakeup_source_set(PM_WAKEUP_SOURCE_INT_GPIO, NULL);
170:           sleep_mode = PM_MODE_NORMAL_SLEEP;
171: 
172:           bk_pm_sleep_mode_set(PM_MODE_NORMAL_SLEEP);
173:           bk_pm_suppress_ticks_and_sleep(0);
174:           break;
175: 
176:         case PM_SLEEP:
177:           _info("Device will enter the sleep mode\n");
178:           bk_gpio_register_isr(GPIO_12, beken_gpio_wakeup_int_wrppper);
179:           bk_gpio_register_wakeup_source(GPIO_18,GPIO_INT_TYPE_FALLING_EDGE);
180:           bk_pm_wakeup_source_set(PM_WAKEUP_SOURCE_INT_GPIO, NULL);
181:           sleep_mode = PM_MODE_LOW_VOLTAGE;
182: 
183:           bk_pm_sleep_mode_set(PM_MODE_LOW_VOLTAGE);
184:           bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_APP,0x1,0x0);
185:           bk_pm_suppress_ticks_and_sleep(0);
186:           extern void up_timer_initialize(void);
187:           up_timer_initialize();
188: #if defined(CONFIG_RTC) && !defined(CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS) && \
189:     !defined(CONFIG_CLOCK_TIMEKEEPING) && !defined(CONFIG_ALARM_ARCH) && \
190:     !defined(CONFIG_TIMER_ARCH)
191:           clock_resynchronize(NULL);
192: #endif
193:           extern void wd_timer(void);
194:           wd_timer();
195:           beken_flush_uart_fifo();
196:           break;
197: 
198:         default:
199:           break;
200:         }
201:     }
202: }
203: #else
204: #  define up_idlepm()
205: #endif

212: /****************************************************************************
213:  * Name: up_idle
214:  *
215:  * Description:
216:  *   up_idle() is the logic that will be executed when there is no other
217:  *   ready-to-run task.  This is processor idle time and will continue until
218:  *   some interrupt occurs to cause a context switch from the idle task.
219:  *
220:  *   Processing in this state may be processor-specific. e.g., this is where
221:  *   power management operations might be performed.
222:  *
223:  ****************************************************************************/
224:

226: {
227: #if defined(CONFIG_SUPPRESS_INTERRUPTS) || defined(CONFIG_SUPPRESS_TIMER_INTS)

229:    * "fake" timer interrupts. Hopefully, something will wake up.
230:    */

235: 
236:   if (sleep_mode == PM_MODE_NORMAL_SLEEP)
237:     {
238:       bk_pm_sleep_mode_set(PM_MODE_NORMAL_SLEEP);
239:       bk_pm_suppress_ticks_and_sleep(0);
240:     }
241: 
242:   up_idlepm();

244: #endif

501:  *
502:  * Description:
503:  *   Get (wait/decrement) a semaphore.
504:  *
505:  * Input Parameters:
506:  *   semaphore  - A pointer of the semaphore handler
507:  *   timeout_ms - The number of milliseconds to wait before returning
508:  *
509:  * Returned Value:
510:  *   Zero (BK_OK) if the semaphore was taken. Otherwise,
511:  *   return -1 (BK_FAIL)
512:  *
513:  ****************************************************************************/

518:   int ret;

520: 
521:   if (timeout_ms == 0)
522:     {
523:       ret = nxsem_trywait(sem);
524:     }
525:   else if (timeout_ms == BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER)
526:     {
527:       ret = nxsem_wait(sem);
528:     }
529:   else
530:     {
531:       ret = nxsem_tickwait(sem, MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms));
532:     }
533: 
534:   if (ret != OK)
535:     {
536:       wlerr("ERROR: Failed to get semaphore:%d\n", ret);
537:     }
538:   
539:   return beken_errno_trans(ret);

715: {
716:   struct mq_attr attr;
717:   struct mq_adpt_s *mq_adpt;
718:   int ret;
719: 
720:   mq_adpt = kmm_malloc(sizeof(struct mq_adpt_s));
721:   if (!mq_adpt)
722:     {
723:       wlerr("ERROR: Failed to kmm_malloc\n");
724:       return BK_FAIL;
725:     }
726:   memset(mq_adpt, 0x0, sizeof(struct mq_adpt_s));
727:   if (name)
728:     {
729:       snprintf(mq_adpt->name, sizeof(mq_adpt->name), "/tmp/%s", name);
730:     }
731:   else
732:     {
733:       snprintf(mq_adpt->name, sizeof(mq_adpt->name), "/tmp/%p", mq_adpt);
734:     }
735:   attr.mq_maxmsg  = number_of_messages;

743:     {
744:       wlerr("ERROR: Failed to create mqueue\n");
745:       kmm_free(mq_adpt);
746:       return beken_errno_trans(ret);
747:     }
748: 
749:   mq_adpt->msgsize = message_size;
750:   *queue           = mq_adpt;
751: 
752:   return beken_errno_trans(ret);
753: }

755: /****************************************************************************
756:  * Name: rtos_push_to_queue
757:  *
758:  * Description:
759:  *   Pushes an object/message onto a Queue.
760:  *
761:  * Input Parameters:
762:  *   queue       - A pointer of the Queue handler
763:  *   message     - The object to be added to the queue
764:  *   timeout_ms  - The number of milliseconds to wait before returning
765:  *
766:  * Returned Value:
767:  *   Zero (BK_OK) if the semaphore was successfully created. Otherwise,
768:  *   return -1 (BK_FAIL)
769:  *
770:  ****************************************************************************/
771: 
772: bk_err_t rtos_push_to_queue(beken_queue_t *queue, void *message, uint32_t timeout_ms)
773: {
774:   int ret;
775:   struct timespec timeout;
776:   struct mq_adpt_s *mq_adpt = (struct mq_adpt_s *)*queue;
777: 
778:   if (timeout_ms == BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER || timeout_ms == 0)
779:     {
780:       ret = file_mq_send(&mq_adpt->mq, (const char *)message,
781:                          mq_adpt->msgsize, 0);
782:       if (ret < 0)
783:         {
784:           wlerr("Failed to send message to mqueue error=%d\n", ret);
785:         }
786:     }
787:   else
788:     {
789:       ret = clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &timeout);
790:       if (ret < 0)
791:         {
792:           wlerr("Failed to get time\n");
793:           return false;
794:         }
795: 
796:       timeout.tv_sec  += timeout_ms / 1000;
797:       timeout.tv_nsec += (timeout_ms % 1000 ) * 1000 * 1000;
798: 
799:       if (timeout.tv_nsec >= 1000000000)
800:         {
801:           timeout.tv_sec += timeout.tv_nsec / 1000000000;
802:           timeout.tv_nsec %= 1000000000;
803:         }
804: 
805:       ret = file_mq_timedsend(&mq_adpt->mq, (const char *)message,
806:                               mq_adpt->msgsize, 0, &timeout);
807:       if (ret < 0)
808:         {
809:           wlerr("Failed to timedsend message to mqueue(%s) error=%d\n", mq_adpt->cname, ret);
810:         }
811:     }
812: 
813:   return beken_errno_trans(ret);
814: }

1: # BEKEN Chip Vendor Support for openvela
2: 
3: [ English | [简体中文](README_zh-cn.md) ]
4: 
5: ## Introduction
6: 
7: This repository contains chip support, board configurations, and hardware
8: drivers from BEKEN Corporation for the openvela operating system. BEKEN is a
9: wireless connectivity chip vendor focused on Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and other solutions for
10: AIoT applications.
11: 
12: The current port targets the **BK7236N** SoC and integrates with the BEKEN
13: Armino SDK through prebuilt libraries and headers under
14: `chips/bk7236n/bk_idk/armino_as_lib/`.
15: 
16: > This directory is only the BK7236N reference implementation. The BK7258 port
17: > must be developed under `openvela_bk7258_dev/vendor/beken/` following the
18: > openvela Vendor directory layout.
19: 
20: ## Repository Structure
21: 
22: ```
23: vendor/beken/
24: ├── boards/                  # Board-specific configurations
25: │   └── bk7236n/
26: │       └── bk7236n-evb/     # BK7236N evaluation board
27: ├── chips/                   # Chip support and hardware abstraction layer
28: │   └── bk7236n/             # BK7236N chip port
29: │       ├── bk_idk/
30: │       │   └── armino_as_lib/  # Prebuilt Armino SDK libs and headers
31: │       └── bootloader.bin     # Prebuilt bootloader binary
32: ├── tools/
33: │   └── cmake_encrypt_crc      # Prebuilt host utility for post-build CRC
34: ├── LICENSE                    # Repository license
35: └── LICENSE-NOTES.md           # Prebuilt binary license notes
36: ```
37: 
38: ## Supported Hardware
39: 
40: ### BK7236N
41: 
42: **BK7236N** is a Wi-Fi and Bluetooth capable SoC for AIoT devices, featuring:
43: 
44: - **Processor**: Arm®v8-M STAR-MC1 MCU
45: - **Wireless Connectivity**: Integrated Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth Low Energy (LE) 5.4
46: - **Applications**: Smart home, wireless modules, and embedded connectivity devices
47: 
48: ### Development Board
49: 
50: The official BK7236N evaluation board configuration is provided under
51: `boards/bk7236n/bk7236n-evb/`.
52: 
53: ## Integration with openvela
54: 
55: openvela is an embedded OS tailored for AIoT applications. This chip vendor
56: repository integrates with openvela through:
57: 
58: 1. **Kconfig Integration**: Chip and board options via `menuconfig`
59: 2. **Build System**: NuttX/openvela CMake and Makefile build infrastructure
60: 3. **Device Drivers**: Standard NuttX lower-half driver interfaces
61: 4. **Armino SDK**: Prebuilt static libraries linked during the NuttX build
62: 
63: ## Configuration and Build
64: 
65: To configure the BK7236N evaluation board with NSH:
66: 
67: ```bash
68: # From the openvela workspace root
69: ./build.sh vendor/beken/boards/bk7236n/bk7236n-evb/nsh
70: 
71: # CMake build (optional)
72: ./build.sh vendor/beken/boards/bk7236n/bk7236n-evb/nsh --cmake
73: ```
74: 
75: To customize features, use `menuconfig` after configuration:
76: 
77: ```bash
78: make -C nuttx menuconfig
79: ```
80:

86: tools) are **BEKEN Proprietary (Restricted)**. Some libraries may embed

96: 
97: ## Contributing
98: 
99: For chip vendor-specific changes, please follow BEKEN's internal development
100: process. For openvela integration issues, please refer to the main openvela
101: contribution guidelines.
102:

105: - **BEKEN Corporation**: Contact your BEKEN representative for chip-specific
106:   support and SDK access
107: - **openvela Integration**: See openvela documentation or community resources

1: # 工作目录说明
2: contest：BK7258 openvela 移植开发分支，所有 BK7258 移植代码在contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing文件夹内的dev分支开发，每次完成更改后都需commit

5: bk_idk：BK7258 基础示例、芯片寄存器和底层驱动参考工程
6: openvela：openvela 原始源码参考
7: vendor_beken：BK7236N 的 openvela 参考实现，不作为 BK7258 的开发目录

10: ## BK7258 移植开发目录和原则
11: 
12: BK7258 移植必须在 `openvela_bk7258_dev/` 内新建并维护标准 vendor 目录：
13: 
14: ```text
15: openvela_bk7258_dev/vendor/beken/
16: ├── boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/
17: └── chips/bk7258/
18: ```
19: 
20: 目录格式必须遵守 `openvela_bk7258_dev/docs/zh-cn/chip_porting/Vendor.md`。不得把 BK7258 代码放在工作区同级的 `vendor_beken/`，也不得直接修改 `bk_avdk_smp/ap` 来实现 openvela 内核移植。
21: 
22: 开发时以工作区同级 `vendor_beken/` 中已有的 BK7236N 实现为代码组织和 NuttX 接入方式参考，重点参考其 `chips/bk7236n/`、`boards/bk7236n/bk7236n-evb/`、Kconfig、Make.defs、CMakeLists、启动、中断、UART 和 SysTick 实现；但不得直接复用 BK7236N 的寄存器、库、启动文件、链接脚本或镜像工具。
23: 
24: # BK7258 AP 移植 openvela 实施与验证方案
25: 
26: > 文档状态：源码交叉验证后的实施基线。本文区分“已由当前仓库证实”“工程假设”和“量产前待原厂确认”。在 BK7258 专属安全启动、OTP/eFuse 和 CPU1 镜像认证资料闭环前，本文只能指导功能性 AP 移植，不能作为量产安全作业指导书。
27: 
28: ## 1. 目标和结论
29: 
30: 本文给出在 BK7258 上运行 openvela 的可执行移植方案。目标是保留现有 CPU0/CP 固件、bootloader、分区和低层芯片服务，将运行在全芯片 CPU1+CPU2 上的 AP SMP 固件替换为 openvela/NuttX，并完成可启动、可调度、可交互和可打包的内核适配。首版允许先在 AP primary core（物理 CPU1）上完成单核 bring-up，但这只是降低调试复杂度的实验路径，正式 AP 兼容目标仍是 CPU1+CPU2 SMP。
31: 
32: 架构结论必须先固定：BK7258 AP 是 Cortex-M33/ARMv8-M Mainline Thumb，不是 Cortex-A/ARMv8-A。移植必须使用 `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm`、NVIC、SysTick 和 MPU；任何 `arch/arm64`、GIC、AArch64 exception level、generic timer、MMU/页表、TF-A/BL31 或 `OUTPUT_ARCH(aarch64)` 方案均不适用。安全模型应讨论 TrustZone-M、SAU/IDAU、PPC/MPC 和可能的 TF-M，而不是 TF-A/EL3。
33: 
34: 本文只采用一条正式实现路径，不把以下做法作为交付方案：
35: 
36: - 不修改 CP 固件来绕过 AP 启动等待。
37: - 不把 openvela 与 FreeRTOS/Armino AP 固件混链。
38: - 不使用只发送 ready 的临时 mailbox 驱动。
39: - 不通过构建后覆盖临时 `app1.bin` 的方式集成 AP 镜像。
40: - 不在 Secure/Non-secure 地址之间运行时自动选择。
41: - 不关闭 MPU、FPU 来回避架构问题。
42: - 不让 AP 自己初始化 PSRAM。
43: 
44: 正式结论如下：
45: 
46: | 全芯片核 | 正式角色 | 本方案处理方式 |
47: | --- | --- | --- |
48: | CPU0 | CP、系统控制核、原 FreeRTOS 固件 | 原样保留 |
49: | CPU1 | AP primary core，当前 AP 固件第一启动目标 | 首版按现有 SPE 配置验证单核 openvela bring-up；实际安全状态必须实测 |
50: | CPU2 | AP secondary，AP SMP 的第二执行核 | 是否可在首版持续保持 reset 必须由启动链和实板确认；正式兼容目标启用 NuttX SMP |
51: 
52: AP 原 FreeRTOS 工程内部把物理 CPU1 称为逻辑 `core0`，把物理 CPU2 称为逻辑 `core1`。这只是 AP SMP 内部的编号，不能用于替代全芯片 CPU 编号。单核 bring-up 时 openvela 只运行逻辑 CPU index 0，BK mailbox 和系统控制固定使用物理 CPU1 对应资源；进入正式 SMP 阶段后必须建立逻辑 CPU 0/1 与物理 CPU1/CPU2 的稳定映射，并分别处理私有 NVIC、cache、TCM 和跨核启动。

132: ### 2.4 AVDK AP/CP 代码事实
133: 
134: CP 启动 AP 的代码路径：
135: 
136: ```text
137: CP main()
138:   -> bk_init()
139:   -> bk_pm_module_vote_boot_cp1_ctrl(..., ON)
140:   -> pm_module_bootup_cpu1()
141:   -> start_cpu1_core()
142:   -> reset_cpu1_core()
143:   -> CPU1 从 AP image 启动
144: ```
145: 
146: 证据：
147: 
148: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/cp_main.c:12-24`
149: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:323-374`
150: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:141-202`

152: CPU1 启动地址由 AP 分区物理地址换算得到：
153: 
154: ```c
155: logical_offset = physical_partition_offset / 34 * 32;
156: boot_address = SOC_FLASH_DATA_BASE + logical_offset;
157: ```
158: 
159: `34` 是 Flash 中 32 字节数据加 2 字节 CRC 的物理占用，代码见：
160: 
161: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:160-170`
162: - `bk_idk/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:141-174`
163: 
164: CP 设置 CPU1 power、boot address 和 software reset：
165: 
166: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:173-195`
167: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258/soc/sys_reg.h:117-141`
168: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_hal.c:297-316`
169: 
170: 原 AP 使用 `Reset_Handler_Cpu0` 作为 AP 镜像入口，但 AP 内部第二核实际通过 `reset_cpu2_core()`启动并进入 `Reset_Handler_Cpu1`：
171: 
172: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_bsp.ld:86-90`
173: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu1.c:259-318`
174: 
175: 因此，本方案先将 openvela 固件作为由物理 CPU1 引导的 AP 镜像处理。CPU2 在首版是否保持 reset 不是既定硬件事实：实施前必须确认当前启动代码、AP ready和heartbeat是否允许CPU1-only；若不允许，则阶段一就必须提供最小CPU2驻留入口或提前接入NuttX SMP。

177: ## 3. 固定地址和安全模型
178: 
179: ### 3.1 Secure 地址模型
180: 
181: 当前 AVDK 和 IDK 的 CPU1 配置均启用 `CONFIG_SPE=1`：
182: 
183: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig:41-43`
184: - `bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258_cp1/bk7258_cp1.defconfig:29-31`
185: 
186: BK 地址定义使用 Secure alias：
187: 
188: - Secure Flash：`0x02000000`
189: - Secure SRAM：`0x28000000`
190: - Secure PSRAM：`0x60000000`
191: - Secure mailbox：`0x41000000` 和 `0x41020000`
192: 
193: Non-secure 视图整体增加 `0x10000000`，但本方案不使用 Non-secure 视图。openvela 固定配置为 Secure 执行环境，所有镜像、向量、外设和共享内存地址都使用 Secure alias。
194: 
195: openvela 配置含义：
196: 
197: ```text
198: CONFIG_ARCH_TRUSTZONE_DISABLED is not required
199: CONFIG_ARCH_TRUSTZONE_SECURE=y
200: CONFIG_ARMV8M_CMSE=y
201: ```
202: 
203: 这里的“Secure”仅表示首版按现有 AP 的 SPE 编译属性和 Secure alias 建立功能移植基线，不等于镜像已经通过 secure boot，也不等于 CPU1 已被限制在最小权限安全域。原 AP 的 `SystemInitCpu0()` 在 `CONFIG_SPE` 下调用 `TZ_SAU_Setup()`：
204: 
205: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/system_cpu0.c`
206: 
207: 因此 openvela 不能简单省略 SAU 步骤。实施时必须先在 golden AP 上导出 SAU、PPC/MPC/PRRO 和关键访问属性，再决定由 openvela 复现原表，还是由不可变 bootloader 预配置并锁定。IDAU 的固定归属和配置锁定规则需要 TRM 说明。
208: 
209: 当前仓库能证明存在安全工具和配置素材，但不能证明 CPU1 AP 已进入最终认证链：
210: 
211: - `bk_idk/middleware/boards/bk7258/csv/security.csv` 默认 `secureboot_en=FALSE`、`flash_aes_type=NONE`。
212: - `bk_idk/middleware/boards/bk7258/csv/otp1.csv` 定义 key hash、security counter、HUK/IAK 等字段。
213: - `bk_idk/middleware/boards/bk7258/csv/ppc.csv` 和 `mpc.csv` 提供生成素材，但默认值不是经威胁建模的最小权限策略。
214: - `bk_idk/tools/env_tools/beken_utils/scripts/partition.py` 和 `pack.py` 存在 `primary_all` 聚合与签名逻辑。
215: - 默认 BK7258 分区没有形成可复核的 BL2/TF-M/CPU1 安全构建产物，也没有 CPU1 单 bit 篡改后拒绝启动的证据。
216: 
217: 开发阶段保持与 golden CP/bootloader 相同的启动模式，不烧写不可逆 OTP/eFuse，不自行切换 Non-secure image。正式量产必须由 bootloader 提供方确认 CPU1 是独立签名对象还是 `primary_all` 子镜像，并从最终签名输入、TLV/hash范围和实板负向测试三方面证明 AP 字节被覆盖。
218: 
219: ### 3.2 Flash 分区
220: 
221: `projects/app_ab` 当前分区如下：
222: 
223: 来源：`bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/auto_partitions.csv:1-16`
224: 
225: | 分区 | 物理起始 | 物理大小 | CRC解码后的虚拟起始 | 虚拟大小 |
226: | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
227: | `primary_bootloader` | `0x000000` | `0x011000` | bootloader管理 | bootloader管理 |
228: | `primary_cp_app` | `0x011000` | `0x154000` | `0x010000` | `0x140000` |
229: | `primary_ap_app` | `0x165000` | `0x121000` | `0x150000` | `0x110000` |
230: 
231: 当前 Secure AP XIP 地址为：
232: 
233: ```text
234: SOC_FLASH_DATA_BASE + CONFIG_AP_VIRTUAL_PARTITION_OFFSET
235: = 0x02000000 + 0x00150000
236: = 0x02150000
237: ```
238: 
239: 最终链接脚本不得长期维护另一份手写地址。`0x02150000`和`0x28010000..0x28064000`只属于当前`app_ab`布局，不是BK7258固定地址。`bk_solution_ai`中的实际AI项目还在`AP_SPINLOCK`之后加入`HARDWARE_ACC`，使AP RAM起点和大小发生变化。建议由目标工程的生成结果转换出最小的 `bk7258_ap_layout.h`，只导出 AP Flash/RAM、保留区和硬件加速区必需宏，再预处理得到 `bk7258_openvela_ap.ld`。不要直接包含整个 BK `sdkconfig.h`，避免和 NuttX `nuttx/config.h` 宏冲突。生成链必须是显式依赖：
240: 
241: ```text
242: target partition CSV
243:   -> BK partition generator
244:   -> partitions_gen.h + ram_regions.h + bk_package.json
245:   -> validate/convert_bk7258_layout
246:   -> bk7258_ap_layout.h
247:   -> preprocess ld.script
248:   -> link openvela AP
249: ```
250: 
251: 干净构建必须先生成布局 header，缺文件或值与 `bk_package.json` 不一致时立即失败。
252: 
253: ### 3.3 SRAM 分区
254: 
255: 当前 `app_ab` SRAM布局来自 `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv:2-10`：
256: 
257: | 区域 | 起始地址 | 大小 | 结束地址 | 所有者 |
258: | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
259: | `AP_SPINLOCK` | `0x28000000` | `0x10000` | `0x2800ffff` | CP/AP协议保留 |
260: | `AP_RAM` | `0x28010000` | `0x54000` | `0x28063fff` | CPU1 openvela |
261: | `CP_RAM` | `0x28064000` | `0x3b700` | `0x2809f6ff` | CPU0 CP |
262: | `PWR_MNG` | `0x2809f700` | `0x100` | `0x2809f7ff` | CP/AP固定ABI |
263: | `SWAP` | `0x2809f800` | `0x800` | `0x2809ffff` | 系统保留 |
264: 
265: openvela 的主 RAM 只能是：
266: 
267: ```text
268: RAM_START = 0x28010000
269: RAM_END   = 0x28064000
270: RAM_SIZE  = 0x54000
271: ```
272: 
273: 必须禁止：
274: 
275: - 清零 CP_RAM、PWR_MNG、SWAP。
276: - 把 `AP_SPINLOCK` 放入 heap。
277: - 把 mailbox共享 buffer放入 CP_RAM或PWR_MNG。
278: - 让链接器隐式生成 `.itcm`、`.dtcm`、`.psram` alloc section。
279: 
280: ### 3.4 PSRAM所有权
281: 
282: PSRAM映射起点为 `0x60000000`。具体容量必须按目标板PSRAM型号和运行时ID确认；基础`app_ab`和AI解决方案可能分别使用不同容量，不能由芯片型号推断。PSRAM职责必须拆分为PHY/电压/时钟与ID检测、AP多媒体静态区域初始化、AP/CP heap和低功耗投票四层，不能统一描述成“全部由CP初始化”或“全部由AP初始化”。
283: 
284: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:249-369`
285: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:346-382`
286: 
287: 正式规则：
288: 
289: 1. CPU1/openvela不得重复执行与CP冲突的PSRAM PHY、电压、时钟和ID检测初始化；实际执行主体由golden启动链确认。
290: 2. 若原AP在CPU1启动后初始化AP多媒体静态PSRAM区域，openvela必须实现等价步骤或通过正式PWC服务完成，不能因禁用PHY初始化而遗漏AP侧内存管理初始化。
291: 3. CPU1使用动态PSRAM前通过正式PWC协议请求/确认上电，并等待semantic response；不能假设存在独立的异步power-on广播。
292: 4. CPU1状态机确认响应成功后才启用独立PSRAM allocator/pool；不能直接复用依赖FreeRTOS的`CONFIG_PSRAM_AS_SYS_MEMORY`和`psram_malloc()`实现。
293: 5. power-off或recovery前冻结独立allocator；只有受控对象引用计数和outstanding allocation均为0时才确认断电，否则返回busy/fail。
294: 6. PSRAM初始配置为MPU normal non-cacheable；未经共享buffer一致性验证不得打开D-cache。
295: 
296: AP侧不得未经确认直接调用 `bk_psram_init()`、`bk_psram_deinit()` 或 `bk_psram_id_auto_detect()`。开工前必须从golden启动链分别确认PHY初始化、AP静态slab初始化和heap初始化的执行主体。openvela实现基于PWC请求/响应的状态机和独立allocator，不复用FreeRTOS AP的PSRAM heap接口。
297: 
298: 首个可交付版本仍然只使用AP SRAM。NuttX通用heap region注册后通常不能安全注销，也不能迁移任意调用者持有的对象，因此动态可掉电PSRAM不得直接加入通用kernel heap；它是由CP管理、由AP专用allocator控制的可选数据面。
299: 
300: ## 4. 正式启动时序
301: 
302: ### 4.1 CPU0/CP阶段
303: 
304: CP保持原代码，不改变 `projects/app_ab/cp/cp_main.c`：
305: 
306: 1. Bootloader/CP完成CPU0启动。
307: 2. CP初始化系统时钟、电源管理、UART0、CPU0侧mailbox和必要共享资源。
308: 3. CP按 `PM_BOOT_CP1_MODULE_NAME_APP`投票打开CPU1。
309: 4. CP清除CPU1 power-down。
310: 5. CP将AP逻辑起始地址写入CPU1 boot offset寄存器。写入值为 `boot_address >> 8`。
311: 6. CP选择CPU1 RXEVT路径，释放CPU1 software reset。
312: 7. CP在 AON RTC 时间窗内等待 `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD`，当前等待上限为500 ms，失败最多重试3次。
313: 
314: 代码依据：
315: 
316: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:323-374`
317: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:173-195`
318: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:203-220`
319: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/pwr_clk.h:26-43`
320: 
321: ### 4.2 CPU1/openvela阶段
322: 
323: CPU1 reset handler必须严格按以下顺序执行：
324: 
325: ```text
326: CPU1 boot vector
327:   1. 关闭异常和外部中断
328:   2. 使用 boot vector 提供的 MSP
329:   3. 设置 MSPLIM/栈边界
330:   4. 设置 CPU1 固定身份，不写 CPU0 身份
331:   5. 初始化 Secure CM33 基础状态
332:   6. 设置 CP10/CP11，建立 hard-float运行环境
333:   7. 初始化必要的 TCM/系统 fault 状态
334:   8. 复制 .data 和 runtime vector；首版禁止可执行 .ramfunc
335:   9. 清零 AP 私有 .bss
336:  10. 初始化 MPU
337:  11. 设置 VTOR 到 RAM runtime vector
338:  12. DSB; ISB
339:  13. 可选初始化UART1 polling输出；不调用NuttX IRQ/同步API
340:  14. 调用 nx_start()，不得返回
341:       -> hardware_initialize()
342:          -> irq_initialize()调用BK up_irqinitialize()
343:          -> clock_initialize()调用SysTick lower-half
344:          -> up_initialize()注册UART和mailbox IRQ 79并初始化transport
345:       -> nx_bringup()/board late
346:          -> 创建PM worker并等待worker_ready握手
347:          -> open MB_CHNL_PWC
348:          -> 发送一次 PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD(1, 0, 0)
349: ```
350: 
351: 这个顺序的依据是：
352: 
353: - C代码调用前必须先完成SP、C runtime和FPU状态。
354: - MPU必须在NuttX访问heap和外设前建立，但runtime vector复制必须在MPU限制生效前完成或放在允许区域。
355: - VTOR必须在NVIC开启前切换，避免中断进入错误向量。
356: - reset阶段不能调用 `irq_attach()`、NuttX spinlock/semaphore或创建worker，因为 `irq_initialize()`、memory和scheduler尚未完成。mailbox必须在 `up_initialize()` 后具备完整RX/ACK能力；PWC复杂动作由PM worker执行，因为CP可能在ready后立即发送命令。
357: - 不得在 `nx_start()`返回后手工调用 `irq_initialize()`、`clock_initialize()`或 `up_initialize()`；这些步骤是上面展示的内部调用链，`nx_start()`正常情况下不返回。
358: - `nx_start()`会初始化NuttX的任务、IRQ、clock和硬件，并最终创建应用启动流程，见 `openvela/nuttx/sched/init/nx_start.c:658-826`。
359: 
360: ready的正式含义是：CPU1已经具备持续运行和响应CP PWC命令的能力，不表示NSH或所有应用已启动。ready发送必须在NuttX调度器、UART、PM worker和完整PWC服务具备后执行，禁止提前只发送一个裸消息。
361: 
362: ### 4.3 NuttX启动阶段
363: 
364: 进入 `nx_start()`后的调用顺序：
365: 
366: ```text
367: nx_start()
368:   -> tasklist_initialize()
369:   -> memory_initialize()
370:   -> hardware_initialize()
371:        -> irq_initialize()
372:        -> clock_initialize()
373:        -> up_initialize()
374:        -> drivers_initialize()
375:        -> board_early_initialize()
376:   -> nx_bringup()
377:        -> board_late_initialize()
378:        -> nsh_main()
379: ```
380: 
381: 对应实现位置：
382: 
383: - `openvela/nuttx/sched/init/nx_start.c:757-826`
384: - `openvela/nuttx/sched/init/nx_bringup.c:293-501`
385: 
386: BK特有的CPU1身份、MPU和vector属于reset阶段；NuttX IRQ注册、UART正式设备和mailbox transport属于 `up_initialize()`；PM worker、PWC命令语义和ready发送属于board bring-up。UART不在board late重复注册。这样既符合NuttX生命周期，也保证ready发出时调度器和RX路径已可用。
387: 
388: ## 5. 双向量镜像设计
389: 
390: ### 5.1 必须保留Flash boot vector
391: 
392: CPU1 boot address直接指向AP镜像起点，因此镜像offset 0必须是有效的 Cortex-M vector：
393: 
394: - word 0：AP RAM范围内的初始MSP。
395: - word 1：位于AP Flash的Thumb reset handler地址；仅凭该值不能证明Secure state。
396: 
397: 原BK镜像在offset `0x100`保留 `BK7236` legacy download magic：
398: 
399: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu0.c:229-231`
400: 
401: 外部IRQ向量表中的该位置会被magic覆盖，因此不能把这份Flash表作为运行时完整向量。
402: 
403: ### 5.2 RAM runtime vector
404: 
405: 正式链接脚本定义两套内容：
406: 
407: ```text
408: .bk_boot_vectors
409:   VMA/LMA: Flash image offset 0
410:   内容: MSP、Reset、bootloader magic兼容布局
411: 
412: .vectors
413:   LMA: Flash
414:   VMA: AP SRAM固定区域
415:   内容: 完整NuttX ARMv8-M向量表
416: ```
417: 
418: Reset handler完成 `.vectors` 从 Flash LMA复制到 AP SRAM VMA，然后设置 `SCB->VTOR`并执行：
419: 
420: ```c
421: __DSB();
422: __ISB();
423: ```
424: 
425: 芯片 Kconfig 必须选择 `ARCH_HAVE_CUSTOM_VECTORS`。不能直接启用NuttX通用 `CONFIG_ARCH_RAMVECTORS`，因为其实现会从当前Flash vector逐项复制：
426: 
427: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/arm_m/arm_ramvec_initialize.c:77-105`
428: 
429: 当前Flash vector含magic时，这会把magic复制成IRQ handler。正式配置关闭通用RAM vector复制，由BK7258芯片层自行完成一次独立的runtime vector安装。
430: 
431: runtime vector可按NuttX公共vector定义生成，但必须作为独立对象放入 `.ram_vectors`，不能从boot table复制：
432: 
433: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/arm_m/arm_vectors.c:102-127`
434: 
435: 链接器必须对两套vector执行512字节对齐断言，原BK脚本已有相同要求：
436: 
437: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_bsp.ld:94-114`
438:

525: ### 6.2 Reset/C runtime
526: 
527: `bk7258_start.c`必须实现：
528: 
529: - `__start()`。
530: - `_sbss/_ebss`清零。
531: - `_eronly -> _sdata/_edata`复制。

533: - runtime vector复制和VTOR切换。
534: - CPU1 Secure基础状态和FPU状态。

536: - 调用 `nx_start()`且不得返回。

538: 不能直接链接原FreeRTOS CMSIS startup，因为它会定义另一套 Reset、SVC、PendSV、SysTick和 `_start`：
539: 
540: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu0.c:360-400`
541: 
542: 应复用其硬件事实，例如VTOR、TCM、FPU和MSPLIM的设置方式，但由openvela芯片层重新组织调用顺序。

544: ### 6.3 IRQ
545: 
546: BK7258 AP IRQ表来源：
547: 
548: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/icu_map.h:28-94`
549: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/bk7258_ap/interrupt.c:114-245`
550: 
551: 已确认的外部NVIC line：
552: 
553: | 外设 | 外部line | NuttX IRQ |
554: | --- | ---: | ---: |
555: | TIMER0 | 3 | 19 |
556: | UART0 | 4 | 20 |
557: | TIMER1 | 13 | 29 |
558: | UART1 | 15 | 31 |
559: | UART2 | 16 | 32 |
560: | MAILBOX统一ICU source | 63 | 79 |
561: 
562: openvela `bk7258_irq.c`实现：
563: 
564: - `up_irqinitialize()`：关闭所有外部IRQ、设置VTOR、配置默认priority、绑定SVC/HardFault/BusFault/UsageFault/MemFault/SecureFault、最后开启中断。
565: - `up_enable_irq()`：按NVIC ISER或系统异常寄存器开启。
566: - `up_disable_irq()`：按NVIC ICER或系统异常寄存器关闭。
567: - `up_prioritize_irq()`：按NVIC优先级寄存器设置。
568: - `arm_ack_irq()`：NVIC无需单独ack，外设ISR负责清设备pending。
569: 
570: BK7258外部中断不是只配置NVIC即可，必须实现完整三级路径：
571: 
572: ```text
573: 外设中断源
574:   -> 系统控制层将source路由到物理CPU1或CPU2
575:   -> 目标core私有NVIC external line
576:   -> NuttX IRQ编号和ISR
577: ```
578: 
579: 例如mailbox必须完成`source 63 -> CPU1系统路由 -> NVIC line 63 -> NuttX IRQ 79`；UART1必须完成`source 15 -> CPU1系统路由 -> NVIC line 15 -> NuttX IRQ 31`。只在`irq.h`定义编号不能使中断到达CPU1。进入SMP阶段后，每个外设还必须明确唯一owner或共享路由策略，不能让CPU1和CPU2同时无保护处理同一外设中断。
580: 
581: 必须在 `include/irq.h` 固化两个编号域，例如 `BK7258_EXTIRQ_MAILBOX=63`、`BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX=BK7258_IRQ_FIRST+63=79`，并设置 `NR_IRQS=80`。`irq_attach()`使用79，NVIC bit和BK gate使用63。`IRQ_MAILBOX0=48`、`IRQ_MAILBOX1=49`等旧header注释不能代替CPU1最终映射。
582: 
583: 还必须区分两套“group”命名：`icu_map.h`中的逻辑group与系统寄存器0-31/32-63 enable bank不是同一概念。mailbox driver实际对source 63调用 `sys_drv_core_intr_group2_enable(..., 1 << (63 - 32))`，即打开32-63 bank的bit31。文档和实现均应使用“32-63 bank”描述寄存器，避免写成含糊的GROUP1。
584: 
585: ### 6.4 Timer
586: 
587: 系统tick固定使用 Cortex-M SysTick：
588: 
589: - `CONFIG_TIMER=y`
590: - `CONFIG_ARMV8M_SYSTICK=y`
591: - `CONFIG_USEC_PER_TICK=1000`
592: - `CONFIG_SCHED_TICKLESS`关闭
593: 
594: 优先复用openvela ARMv8-M SysTick lower-half，而不是自写旧式ISR直接调用 `nxsched_process_timer()`：
595: 
596: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/beken_timerisr.c`
597: - `openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/armv8-m/Kconfig`
598: 
599: `up_timer_initialize()`调用 `systick_initialize(true, CONFIG_CPU_FREQ_HZ, -1)`，再调用 `up_timer_set_lowerhalf()`。
600: 
601: 首版固定CPU1频率，不支持runtime DVFS，直到确认CP通知发生在频率切换前还是后、SysTick时钟源及时间补偿协议。仅暂停并重装reload会丢tick，不能作为正式DVFS实现。后续必须设计pre-change/post-change握手、临界区更新和已流逝时间补偿测试后再启用。
602: 
603: 不把BK TIMER0同时用于系统tick，避免与CP和外设共享同一timer资源。
604: 
605: ### 6.5 UART1控制台
606: 
607: 正式console使用UART1：
608: 
609: - UART1 TX：GPIO0。
610: - UART1 RX：GPIO1。
611: - 115200 8N1。
612: - UART0继续归CPU0/CP使用。
613: 
614: UART0是板上的物理日志口：BK7258 UART0 TX/RX 经 CH340 USB转串口芯片接到 Type-C 接口，PC 端通过 Type-C 枚举出 CH340 串口设备接收日志。因此 CP 的所有 log、AP 经 mailbox 转发的 log，以及烧录工具的下载通信，都通过这条 UART0->CH340->Type-C->PC 物理链路完成。openvela AP 的 UART1 控制台是独立于该物理口的另一条通路，不经过 CH340。
615: 
616: 地址和GPIO映射见：
617: 
618: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/gpio_map.h:26-40`
619: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/gpio_map.h:169-179`
620: 
621: 当前 `app_ab` AP GPIO配置把GPIO0/1作为I2C1，见：
622: 
623: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/ap/config/bk7258_ap/usr_gpio_cfg.h:22-25`
624: 
625: openvela board配置必须明确接管GPIO0/1为UART1，不能同时启用AP I2C1。CP GPIO配置不修改。
626: 
627: 芯片层实现：
628: 
629: - `bk7258_lowputc.c`：early polling TX，供`up_putc()`和fault早期日志使用；所需GPIO0/1 pinmux必须在reset/chip early阶段完成。
630: - `bk7258_serial.c`：实现UART lower-half的setup/shutdown/attach/detach/receive/rxint/send/txint/txready/txempty。
631: - UART ISR清除UART状态，然后调用 `uart_recvchars()`和 `uart_xmitchars()`。
632: - `arm_earlyserialinit()`在`nx_start()`前建立UART寄存器。
633: - `arm_serialinit()`注册 `/dev/console`和 `/dev/ttyS1`。
634: 
635: UART控制台不能依赖CPU0 mailbox日志转发，因为openvela替换的是全芯片CPU1，且启动故障时CPU0转发服务可能还未可用。
636: 
637: 官方AP日志路径通常通过mailbox转发到CP的UART0，因此控制台分两阶段实现：第一阶段使用UART1作为early bring-up和NSH独立控制台；第二阶段按需增加mailbox log transport以兼容统一日志。两条路径不能共享未加保护的输出缓冲，也不能把mailbox虚拟UART误当成物理UART1。
638: 
639: ### 6.6 MPU、FPU和cache
640: 
641: 正式配置启用：
642: 
643: ```text
644: CONFIG_ARM_MPU=y
645: CONFIG_ARM_MPU_RESET=y
646: CONFIG_ARCH_FPU=y
647: CONFIG_ARMV8M_CMSE=y
648: CONFIG_ARM_DSP is not set
649: ```
650: 
651: MPU region不是原BK宽范围表的原样复制，而是基于其memory attribute重新收紧所有权。region数量必须从MPU `TYPE.DREGION`读回，显式写入 `CONFIG_ARM_MPU_NREGIONS`并在启动时校验；在TRM或实测前不得写死16，也不能盲目分配超过硬件能力的region。若region不足，首版只保留Flash、AP SRAM、外设和必需共享窗口，PSRAM/QSPI后置。目标策略：
652: 
653: | 区域 | 地址 | 属性 |
654: | --- | --- | --- |
655: | Flash | `0x02000000-0x02ffffff` | Secure RO/X，write-through |
656: | AP instruction alias | `0x08000000-0x0809ffff` | RO/X |
657: | DTCM | `0x20000000-0x20003fff` | RW/XN，non-cacheable |
658: | AP SRAM | `0x28010000-0x28063fff` | RW/XN，shareable；不得包含CP RAM |
659: | PWR_MNG | `0x2809f700-0x2809f7ff` | RW，Device，shareable |
660: | peripheral | `0x40000000-0x5fffffff` | Device，XN，shareable |
661: | PSRAM | `0x60000000-0x63ffffff` | RW/XN，non-cacheable |
662: | QSPI0 | `0x64000000-0x67ffffff` | non-cacheable，XN |
663: | QSPI1 | `0x68000000-0x6bffffff` | non-cacheable，XN |
664: 
665: 参考：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/mpu_cfg.c:38-149`。原表将SRAM覆盖到 `0x3fffffff`，不能提供AP/CP边界；PWR_MNG若作为AP SRAM region的override，必须明确更高优先级region编号。首版禁止 `.ramfunc`，避免与SRAM整体XN策略矛盾。
666: 
667: FPU从reset阶段启用CP10/CP11，所有对象统一hard-float。NuttX公共层负责线程浮点上下文保存，不能把FPU支持延后到另一个ABI。
668: 
669: I-cache和D-cache在正式第一版保持关闭，因为现有 `mbox0_adapter.c`在发送端没有与接收端对称的D-cache clean/invalidate：
670: 
671: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:15-38`
672: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:99-128`
673: 
674: 后续若启用D-cache，必须先将mailbox共享buffer放到non-cacheable MPU region，或者为发送、接收和所有权交接实现完整32字节cache line clean/invalidate、DMB和DSB。
675: 
676: ## 7. Mailbox v2和PWC服务
677: 
678: ### 7.1 不能使用旧版裸mailbox
679: 
680: AP配置明确启用 `CONFIG_MAILBOX_V2_0`：
681: 
682: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig:28-30`
683: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/common/CMakeLists.txt:71-81`
684: 
685: mailbox v2的实际数据链为：
686: 
687: ```text
688: logical command
689:   -> mailbox_channel物理头
690:   -> AP共享SRAM buffer
691:   -> MBOX0 FIFO发送buffer pointer + length
692:   -> 对端从共享SRAM读取16字节message
693:   -> command/ACK状态机
694: ```
695: 
696: 证据：
697: 
698: - physical header含 `cmd/state/ctrl/tx_seq/logical_chnl`：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:51-71`
699: - logical TX写入sequence和logical channel：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c:207-223`
700: - mailbox发送共享buffer指针和长度：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c:99-128`
701: - MBOX0 FIFO长度和channel配置：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c:6-27`
702: - 当前AP CMake编译v2驱动：`bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/CMakeLists.txt:392-423`

704: ### 7.2 CPU1必须实现的transport
705: 
706: openvela芯片层必须完整移植以下逻辑，不能仅保留ready：
707: 
708: 1. `mbox0_ll.h`、`mbox0_struct.h`、`mbox0_hal.c`对应的寄存器和FIFO操作。
709: 2. CPU1 channel的FIFO起始地址、长度和owner配置。
710: 3. `INT_SRC_MAILBOX`外部line 63到NuttX IRQ 79的注册、32-63 gate使能、清pending和FIFO drain。
711: 4. RX FIFO中所有message的循环读取，不能每次中断只取一个。
712: 5. 发送共享buffer池，command和ACK独立且32字节对齐；每个buffer必须有明确的in-flight/已消费所有权，不能仅靠两个buffer轮换假定对端已读完。
713: 6. physical message的pointer/length envelope；接收时检查source、destination、指针窗口、对齐、长度、加法溢出和buffer所有权。
714: 7. logical channel source/destination编码。
715: 8. `tx_seq`递增、reset和重新同步。
716: 9. `CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX`、`CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX`和`CHNL_CTRL_RESET`处理。
717: 10. command RX、ACK RX、发送完成和busy状态机。
718: 11. NuttX临界区/spinlock保护，禁止使用FreeRTOS临界区和semaphore。
719: 12. transport错误计数、超时、FIFO full、非法source/destination和reset恢复。
720: 
721: 应以这些文件为协议移植依据，而不是自行重新定义格式：
722: 
723: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c`
724: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_adapter.c`
725: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/common/hal/mbox0_hal.c`
726: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/mbox0_ll.h`
727: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mailbox_channel.c`
728: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h`
729: 
730: CPU1的逻辑身份固定：
731: 
732: ```c
733: #define SELF_CPU MAILBOX_CPU1
734: ```
735: 
736: PWC是CPU1到CPU0的逻辑channel：
737: 
738: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:47-100`

740: ### 7.3 PWC方向和命令服务
741: 
742: PWC命令定义：
743: 
744: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/pwr_clk.h:26-43`
745: 
746: PWC不能按“CPU1收到后执行”统一描述。CP/AP两侧源码表明power/clock/frequency主要是AP向CP请求，由CP执行系统硬件动作并返回；ready由AP发送；PSRAM/recovery存在CP向AP通知。编码前必须为每个命令从两侧调用点生成完整协议表，至少包含request direction、执行主体、3个参数、transport ACK、semantic response、timeout和recovery。已确认的主方向：
747: 
748: | 命令 | 主请求方向 | 执行主体/CPU1职责 |
749: | --- | --- | --- |
750: | `PM_POWER_CTRL_CMD` | AP -> CP | CP执行系统电源操作；AP等待并处理响应 |
751: | `PM_CLK_CTRL_CMD` | AP -> CP | CP执行主时钟操作；AP处理响应 |
752: | `PM_SLEEP_CTRL_CMD` | AP -> CP | CP协调睡眠；AP侧状态机配合 |
753: | `PM_CPU_FREQ_CTRL_CMD` | AP -> CP | CP执行频率操作；首版AP固定频率并拒绝未支持的DVFS |
754: | `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD` | AP -> CP | AP只发送一次，CP记录ready |
755: | `PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD` | 双向/状态通知 | AP不得重复执行与CP冲突的PHY初始化；按golden职责完成AP静态区域和独立allocator状态管理 |
756: | `PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD` | CP -> AP查询为主 | AP返回受控PSRAM allocator使用量 |
757: | `PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD` | CP -> AP | AP投递worker输出受控分配状态 |
758: | `PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD` | CP -> AP | AP quiesce后返回状态 |
759: | 其他sleep/wakeup/AP状态命令 | 逐调用点确认 | ISR仅ACK/入队，worker执行语义动作 |
760: 
761: 原AP PWC RX handler已给出命令处理边界：
762: 
763: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:288-439`
764: 
765: openvela实现必须保持同样的分层：
766: 
767: ```text
768: mailbox ISR
769:   -> 校验transport和命令
770:   -> 完成必要ACK
771:   -> 投递PWC消息到高优先级PM worker
772:   -> PM worker执行电源/时钟/PSRAM/recovery动作
773:   -> 发送语义响应
774: ```
775: 
776: ISR禁止执行PSRAM初始化、频率切换、文件系统操作、阻塞等待或复杂日志输出。
777: 
778: ### 7.4 WDT、heartbeat和Flash代理
779: 
780: BK7258硬件WDT由CP管理，AP没有可独占的本地硬件watchdog。openvela AP必须实现的是：
781: 
782: - 周期性AP heartbeat，默认协议和超时时间以当前CP实现为准。
783: - 通过mailbox请求CP执行全系统reboot。
784: - heartbeat丢失、mailbox失联和AP recovery的状态处理。
785: - 如向NuttX注册watchdog lower-half，必须明确标记为CP远端代理，不能直接访问WDT寄存器或声称提供独立AP硬件watchdog。
786: 
787: AP对Flash的能力也必须拆分：CPU1可从AP code分区XIP读取和执行，但Flash擦除、编程、配置写入和OTA必须通过CP/mailbox代理。后续MTD实现应是mailbox-backed Flash proxy，并至少校验分区白名单、地址溢出、擦除粒度、XIP冲突、超时和断电恢复；不得照搬单核平台的直接Flash controller lower-half。
788: 
789: ### 7.5 Ready时序
790: 
791: ready必须在以下条件全部满足后发送：
792: 
793: - runtime vector已经安装。
794: - MPU已经生效。
795: - MBOX0物理层已经初始化。
796: - CPU1 RX FIFO已清空。
797: - NuttX IRQ79已经注册，NVIC line63和32-63 gate已经使能。
798: - `MB_CHNL_PWC`已经open并注册RX/ACK回调。
799: - NuttX heap、IRQ和clock基础设施已经初始化。
800: - NuttX调度器已运行，PM worker线程已真正执行队列初始化并置位 `worker_ready`，board bring-up以有界等待确认，而不是仅检查 `kthread_create()`成功。
801: - `ready_sent`状态保证同一次boot只发送一次。
802: 
803: ready发送内容固定为：
804: 
805: ```text
806: cmd    = PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD (0x5)
807: param1 = 1
808: param2 = 0
809: param3 = 0
810: ```
811: 
812: CP等待窗口当前为500 ms，连续3次失败后可触发重启：
813: 
814: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:341-371`
815: 
816: 目标是冷启动 ready P99 小于200 ms，为CP窗口保留足够裕量。
817:

940: ## 10. Board初始化和服务启动
941: 
942: ### 10.1 board early
943: 
944: GPIO0/1到UART1的pinmux必须在 `up_initialize()`调用 `arm_serialinit()`之前完成；若需要early polling日志，则在 `bk7258_start.c`/chip early阶段首次完成pinmux和UART基础配置。`board_early_initialize()`只执行其后的非阻塞板级动作：
945: 
946: - 校验GPIO0/1已经切换为UART1，不把board early作为首次pinmux点。
947: - 完成不影响early console的其余板级GPIO配置。
948: - 必要的CPU1 GPIO状态。
949: - 不启动USB、Wi-Fi、媒体和CPU2。
950: 
951: 不得在此阶段等待semaphore、访问文件系统或启动复杂服务。openvela文档明确early hook位于核心组件完成前：
952: 
953: - `openvela/docs/zh-cn/device_dev_guide/kernel/boot_process.md:37-45`
954: 
955: ### 10.2 board late
956: 
957: `board_late_initialize()`执行：
958: 
959: - 启动PWC PM worker并在其可运行后发送CPU1 ready。
960: - 启动mailbox诊断和错误统计线程。
961: - 发送CPU1 ready前确认transport状态。
962: - 初始化NuttX基础设备。
963: 
964: UART1正式驱动在 `up_initialize()` 调用 `arm_serialinit()`时注册；board late不得重复注册 `/dev/console`。
965: 
966: ### 10.3 board app initialize
967: 
968: `board_app_initialize()`执行：
969: 
970: - `/dev/console`验证。
971: - procfs、ROMFS和NSH依赖初始化。
972: - 后续启用独立PSRAM allocator，但必须先完成向CP请求上电并收到成功的semantic response。
973: 
974: 不在首版启动任何要求CPU2、Wi-Fi、BT、媒体或AP SMP的服务。

976: ## 11. 构建和正式打包
977: 
978: ### 11.1 两个独立工程
979: 
980: openvela AP和BK CP保持独立构建：
981: 
982: ```text
983: openvela
984:   -> BK7258 CPU1 SPE配置的ELF/map/raw binary
985: 
986: bk_avdk_smp
987:   -> bootloader
988:   -> CPU0 CP app.bin
989:   -> partitions_gen.h / ram_regions.h / bk_package.json
990:   -> all-app.bin
991: ```
992: 
993: 不把openvela源文件加入 `bk_avdk_smp/ap` 的CMake。这样可以避免两套startup、libc wrapper、heap、SVC、PendSV和SysTick重复定义。
994: 
995: ### 11.2 正式AP image provider
996: 
997: 现有打包链在 `copy_binaries_to_pack_dir()`中按照 `apps_info`复制CP/AP：
998: 
999: - `bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_process/bk_project.py:145-159`
1000: - `bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_process/bk_sdk/bk_sdk_project.py:162-175`
1001: 
1002: 正式改造方式：
1003: 
1004: 1. 为BK package目标增加 `EXTERNAL_AP_BIN`、可选 `EXTERNAL_AP_ELF`和metadata参数。
1005: 2. `bk_sdk_project.py`将AP role的 `app_info.build_bin`直接设为外部输入；不要依赖并不存在或未经证实的字符串条件猜测role。
1006: 3. CP仍使用正常 `app.bin`。
1007: 4. package开始前检查外部AP ELF/raw的hash、大小和build metadata。
1008: 5. `copy_binaries_to_pack_dir()`直接把外部AP raw复制到packager需要的AP firmware文件名。
1009: 6. 禁止先复制原AP再覆盖临时文件。
1010: 7. `bk_build_package.py`继续调用标准packager，不改变最终包格式。
1011: 
1012: 当前packager执行顺序是先copy再pack：
1013: 
1014: - `bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_process/bk_build_package.py:69-80`
1015: 
1016: packager从`bk_package.json`的`firmware`字段读取输入文件：
1017: 
1018: - `bk_avdk_smp/tools/env_tools/bk_py_libs/bk_packager/bk_packager_json.py:44-68`
1019: 
1020: 因此正式接口必须以生成的JSON和AP role为准，不能硬编码`app1.bin`作为不可变协议。当前工程通常将AP映射为`app1.bin`，但该名称由 `bk_sdk_project.py`产生。
1021: 
1022: ### 11.3 正式构建目标
1023: 
1024: 目标依赖关系：
1025: 
1026: ```text
1027: make bk7258_openvela
1028:   -> generate partitions and ram_regions
1029:   -> build original CPU0 CP
1030:   -> build openvela CPU1 AP
1031:   -> validate AP ELF/raw
1032:   -> external AP image provider
1033:   -> package all-app.bin
1034:   -> validate final package
1035: ```
1036: 
1037: 原 `bk7258_ap`目标保留为golden/reference构建，但不作为openvela package依赖。这样可以在寄存器、启动向量和mailbox联调时随时生成原AP进行对照。
1038: 
1039: ### 11.4 自动门禁
1040: 
1041: 构建必须失败于以下任一条件：
1042: 
1043: - `readelf -A`和反汇编不能证明是ARMv8-M Mainline Thumb、Cortex-M33。
1044: - CPU属性不是Cortex-M33、hard-float、FPv5-SP-D16。
1045: - 出现DSP指令属性。
1046: - image offset 0的初始SP不在 `0x28010000..0x28064000`。
1047: - reset vectorbit0未置位、地址不落入AP Flash。仅凭地址和bit0不能证明Secure state，Secure必须靠寄存器读回和fault测试。
1048: - offset `0x100/0x104`两个word不是 `0x32374b42/0x00003633`。
1049: - runtime vector未按512字节对齐。
1050: - `.data/.bss/.ramfunc/stack/heap`越过 `0x28064000`。
1051: - 出现未经批准的PSRAM或CP RAM alloc section。
1052: - AP logical raw超过虚拟AP分区 `0x110000`，或 `ceil(raw_size / 32) * 34`超过物理分区 `0x121000`。
1053: - CP/bootloader hash与golden不一致。
1054: - final package解码后的AP内容与openvela raw不一致。

1056: ## 12. 实施步骤和验收
1057: 
1058: ### 阶段一：固化golden
1059: 
1060: 构建原 `projects/app_ab`，保存：
1061: 
1062: - CPU0 CP ELF/map/raw。
1063: - 原AP ELF/map/raw。
1064: - bootloader和 `bk_package.json`。
1065: - `all-app.bin`。
1066: - CPU1启动日志、ready耗时和mailbox v2 trace。
1067: 
1068: 必须完成100次冷启动，记录CPU1启动到ready的延迟分布。
1069: 
1070: ### 阶段二：CPU1按SPE基线启动
1071: 
1072: 实现：
1073: 
1074: - Secure hard-float toolchain。
1075: - Flash boot vector。
1076: - RAM runtime vector。
1077: - C runtime。
1078: - MPU。
1079: - FPU。
1080: - UART1 early output。
1081: 
1082: 验收：
1083: 
1084: - CPU1能从当前目标项目生成的AP XIP origin取vector；基础`app_ab`才使用`0x02150000`。
1085: - MSP位于AP RAM。
1086: - VTOR最终位于RAM runtime vector。
1087: - 无HardFault、BusFault、MemManageFault或SecureFault。
1088: - 100次CPU1启动无随机失败。
1089: - 导出并对比golden/openvela的安全状态、SAU和PPC/MPC关键寄存器；在完成前只称“SPE功能基线”，不称“可信启动”。

1: # vendor Overview
2: 
3: \[ English | [简体中文](README_zh-cn.md) \]
4: 
5: The `vendor` repository holds the board support packages (BSP), chip drivers, and product projects from various SoC vendors. openvela adapts to different chip platforms and development boards through this repository, making it the primary directory for hardware porting work.
6: 
7: ## Recommended Contest Boards
8: 
9: | Board | Platform | Board Guide |
10: | ----- | -------- | ----------- |
11: | ESP32-S3 EYE | Espressif ESP32-S3 | [esp32s3-eye](https://github.com/open-vela/vendor_espressif/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/boards/esp32s3/esp32s3-eye/README.md) |
12: | Gemini-S1 | Allwinner R528 | [r528s3-gemini-s1](https://github.com/open-vela/vendor_allwinnertech/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/boards/r528/r528s3-gemini-s1/README.md) |
13: | LCKFB Huangshan Pi | SiFli SF32LB52 | [lckfb_huangshan_pi](https://github.com/open-vela/vendor_sifli/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/boards/sf32lb52/lckfb_huangshan_pi/README.md) |
14: 
15: ## Directory Structure
16: 
17: The top level is organized by **chip vendor**, one directory per vendor, for example:
18: 
19: | Directory | Description |
20: | --------- | ----------- |
21: | `allwinnertech/` | Allwinner platform support. |
22: | `bes/` | BES (Bestechnic) platform support. |
23: | `espressif/` | Espressif platform support. |
24: | `flagchip/` | Flagchip platform support. |
25: | `gigadevice/` | GigaDevice platform support. |
26: | `infineon/` | Infineon platform support. |
27: | `sifli/` | SiFli platform support. |
28: | `st/` | STMicroelectronics platform support. |
29: | `xiaomi/` | Xiaomi in-house platform support. |
30: | `template/` | Vendor project template for quickly creating a new vendor directory (see below). |
31: 
32: > The list above is illustrative; the actual set of vendors depends on the repository contents.
33: 
34: Each vendor directory typically follows this structure:
35: 
36: | Subdirectory | Description |
37: | ------------ | ----------- |
38: | `chips/<chip>/` | Chip-level drivers and hardware abstraction (GPIO, SPI, I2C, HAL, etc.). |
39: | `boards/<chip>/<board>/` | Board support package: boot code, pin configuration, `configs/` build configs, etc. |
40: 
41: ## Adding a New Vendor
42: 
43: `template/` provides a standard vendor project template. Use its `rename.py` to quickly scaffold an initial project for a new platform:
44: 
45: ```bash
46: # 1. Copy the template to a new vendor directory
47: cp -r template <vendor_name>
48: cd <vendor_name>
49: 
50: # 2. Replace the template placeholders with the actual vendor / board / chip names
51: python rename.py <vendor_name> <board_name> <chip_name>
52: 
53: # 3. Remove template-only files
54: rm rename.py
55: 
56: # 4. Build to verify (using the generated board config path as an example)
57: ./build.sh vendor/<vendor_name>/boards/<chip_name>/<board_name>/configs/nsh -j8
58: ```
59: 
60: ## Related Documentation
61: 
62: - Chip porting guide: see the [Chip Porting guide](https://github.com/open-vela/docs/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/en/chip_porting/porting_guide.md).
63: - Contest participants should base their hardware adaptation work on the contest branch `dev-ai-contest-2026`.

55: static isr_func_t isr_list[INT_SRC_NONE] = {0};

57: static int bk_int_src_from_irq(int irq)
58: {
59:   int src;
60: 
61:   for (src = 0; src < INT_SRC_NONE; src++)
62:     {
63:       if ((icu_int_map_table[src].int_bit + BK7236N_IRQ_FIRST) == irq)
64:         {
65:           return src;
66:         }
67:     }
68: 
69:   return -EINVAL;
70: }

72: static int bk_int_isr_wrap(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
73: {
74:   int src = bk_int_src_from_irq(irq);
75:   isr_func_t isr;
76: 
77:   UNUSED(context);
78:   UNUSED(arg);
79: 
80:   if (src < 0)
81:     {
82:       return src;
83:     }
84: 
85:   isr = isr_list[src];
86:   if (isr == NULL)
87:     {
88:       return -EINVAL;
89:     }
90: 
91:   isr();
92:   return 0;
93: }

100: *
101: * Input Parameters:

103: *   isr_callback:The callback function of interrupt src.
104: *   arg:The arguments of the callback function .
105: *
106: * Returned Value:
107: *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno on failure
108: *
109: ****************************************************************************/
110: 
111: int bk_int_isr_register(icu_int_src_t src, isr_func_t isr_callback, void *arg)
112: {
113:   ICU_RETURN_ON_INVALID_DEVS(src);
114: 
115:   const icu_int_map_t *icu_int_map = &icu_int_map_table[src];
116:   uint8_t int_num = 0;
117:   int_num = icu_int_map->int_bit + BK7236N_IRQ_FIRST;
118:   up_disable_irq(int_num);
119:   isr_list[src] = isr_callback;
120:   irq_attach(int_num, bk_int_isr_wrap, arg);
121: #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_IRQPRIO
122:   up_prioritize_irq(int_num, icu_int_map->int_prio);
123: #endif

56:  *   initialization logic has been started and before the libraries have
57:  *   been initialized.  OS services and driver services are available.

## 1.3 IRQ integration

### `/home/mi/vela_competition/vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/beken_irq.c`

Required NuttX architecture APIs:

```c
void up_irqinitialize(void);
void up_enable_irq(int irq);
void up_disable_irq(int irq);
void arm_ack_irq(int irq);

#ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_IRQPRIO
int up_prioritize_irq(int irq, int priority);
#endif
```

Behavior:

- Clears all external NVIC enables.
- Initializes RAM vectors if `CONFIG_ARCH_RAMVECTORS`.
- Sets system and external IRQ priorities.
- Attaches NuttX ARM handlers:
  - `arm_svcall`
  - `arm_hardfault`
  - `arm_memfault`
  - `arm_busfault`
  - `arm_usagefault`
  - `arm_dbgmonitor`
- Installs BK NMI and reserved handlers.
- Raises SVC priority so SVC can preempt BASEPRI-masked critical sections.
- Enables global interrupts.

Portable to BK7258:

- The NuttX API signatures.
- Cortex-M33 NVIC enable/disable/priority mechanics.
- Exception-handler attachment pattern.
- SVC priority treatment.

Must be replaced:

- `BK7236N_IRQ_*` numbering and `NR_IRQS`.
- Interrupt-source routing/gating.
- Reset-reason/NMI implementation.
- Vector ownership and target security state.

### `/home/mi/vela_competition/vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/beken_interrupt_base.c`

Bridges Armino’s interrupt ABI to NuttX:

```c
typedef void (*isr_func_t)(void);

int bk_int_isr_register(icu_int_src_t src,
                        isr_func_t isr_callback,
                        void *arg);

int bk_int_isr_unregister(icu_int_src_t src);

int bk_int_set_priority(icu_int_src_t int_src,
                        uint32_t int_priority);

int32_t bk_get_int_number(icu_int_src_t src);
```

Mapping:

```text
Armino icu_int_src_t
  -> icu_int_map_table[src].int_bit
  -> NuttX IRQ = int_bit + BK7236N_IRQ_FIRST
  -> irq_attach()
```

Notable limitation: the registered `arg` is passed to `irq_attach()`, but `bk_int_isr_wrap()` ultimately invokes `isr()` without arguments.

Adaptable to BK7258 only if BK7258 libraries still expect this ABI. For a new source-only BK7258 console/mailbox path, direct `irq_attach()` is cleaner. BK7258 additionally requires system-control routing to physical CPU1 before NVIC enable.

## 2.3 Linker contract needed by the port

The BK7236N script supplies these symbols used by startup/heap code:

```text
__StackTop
__StackLimit
_vectors / __Vectors
_ebss
_eram
_bss_start / _bss_end
__data_flash_begin
__data_start__ / __data_end__
__copy_table_start__ / __copy_table_end__
__zero_table_start__ / __zero_table_end__
```

BK7258 needs an equivalent contract, but with a different layout:

```text
AP XIP origin, current app_ab example: 0x02150000
AP SRAM:                         0x28010000..0x28064000
```

Required BK7258 sections should include:

```text
.bk_boot_vectors      at AP image offset 0
.ram_vectors          complete runtime vectors in AP SRAM
.text/.rodata
.init_array
.ARM.extab/.ARM.exidx
.data > RAM AT > FLASH
.bss
stack
heap ending at AP_RAM exclusive end
```

The script must assert that `.data`, `.bss`, vectors, stack, and heap cannot enter CP RAM or the AP spinlock reservation.

# 5. BK7258-specific dependencies for a bootable NSH

Repository evidence establishes:

- AP architecture: Cortex-M33/ARMv8-M.
- Compile ABI:

```text
-mcpu=cortex-m33+nodsp
-mfpu=fpv5-sp-d16
-mfloat-abi=hard
-mcmse
```

Source:

```text
/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/compile-options.cmake
```

- AP reference config enables SPE, MPU, mailbox v2 and two-core AP SMP:

```text
/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig
```

- Current `app_ab` partition inputs:

```text
/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/auto_partitions.csv
/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
```

- Confirmed external interrupt lines:

```text
TIMER0   3  -> NuttX IRQ 19
UART0    4  -> NuttX IRQ 20
TIMER1  13  -> NuttX IRQ 29
UART1   15  -> NuttX IRQ 31
UART2   16  -> NuttX IRQ 32
MAILBOX 63  -> NuttX IRQ 79
```

Source:

```text
/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/soc/icu_map.h
```

A minimal independent UART shell needs startup, runtime vectors, IRQ, SysTick, heap and UART1. However, a system-compatible AP image also needs mailbox v2 and PWC ready before CP’s boot deadline; otherwise the CP can retry or reset CPU1 even if NSH itself is running.

Thus the practical minimum is:

1. BK7258 boot vector and reset runtime.
2. Secure/FPU/MPU state.
3. RAM runtime vector and VTOR switch.
4. NuttX IRQ implementation.
5. SysTick.
6. AP-private heap.
7. UART1 pinmux, polling console and interrupt serial lower-half.
8. MBOX0 transport and IRQ route.
9. Mailbox logical channel/PWC worker.
10. One-shot `PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD`.
11. NSH board hooks and defconfig.
12. AP binary integration into the BK standard packager.

9. Implement PWC worker and delayed one-time AP-ready notification.
